uiScaleDescription: Adjust the size of the entire interface.
focusModeDescription: Hover a sentence to keep only its source and translation clear.
focusHideOverlays: Hide reference overlays in Focus mode
focusHideOverlaysDescription: Hide figure, table, and reference previews only while Focus mode is enabled.
focusKeyboardHelp: Click a sentence to pin it, use arrow keys to move, and Escape to release.
suggestedQuestions: Suggested and related questions for AI answers
suggestedQuestionsDescription: Turn off to stop generating follow-up questions below answers.
categoryGeneralDescription: Configure the interface language, UI size, and theme.
categoryTranslationDescription: Configure source and target languages, translation behavior, and the custom prompt.
categoryViewerDescription: Configure PDF viewing behavior and mode-specific reading tools.
categoryShortcutsDescription: View the keyboard shortcuts available in EasyPaper.
shortcutsBrowserNote: Ctrl/Cmd means Ctrl on Windows and Linux or Command on macOS. Browsers may handle some reserved shortcuts first. Shortcuts work in their respective screens; memo shortcuts take priority while editing. Workspace shortcuts are disabled while a modal is open.
shortcutMode: Switch research or general document mode
shortcutTabReorder: Reorder a tab in the tab bar
shortcutDeleteTab: Close a tab in the tab bar
shortcutModeFocus: Switch mode on a mode button
shortcutChatSend: Send chat message or insert line break
shortcutMemoInline: Bold, italic, link, or inline code
shortcutMemoList: Numbered, bullet, task, or quote list
categoryAutomationDescription: Choose what to generate automatically after AI answers and document processing.
categoryModelDescription: Manage AI engines, provider credentials, Ollama, and OpenAlex.
categoryAccountDescription: Manage account details and sign-in security policies.
categoryDataSystemDescription: Clear caches and update the server or desktop app.
categoryInfoDescription: View EasyPaper project and version information.
versionHistoryDescription: View the current version and open the complete changelog.
versionHistoryLoadFailed: Failed to load version and changelog
